client: I've been feeling really overwhelmed with anxiety about my presentation at the annual conference next week. Yesterday, during practice, I completely forgot my lines, and it just made everything worse. I can’t shake this feeling that I’m going to mess up in front of everyone, and I’m starting to doubt whether I can even do this.
therapist: It sounds like you're experiencing a lot of anxiety and self-doubt about your upcoming presentation, especially after feeling unprepared during practice. That overwhelming sensation can really cloud your confidence, making it tough to see your own abilities. Remember, it's normal to feel anxious before a big moment, but it might be helpful to focus on your preparation and remind yourself of times you've succeeded in the past.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, moderate-paced speech
